mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear at Harriet Park, the moon is in a Waxing Gibbous phase, and we will hit an overnight low of 42 degrees with no rain expected.

The city is currently reviewing plans to expand the Public Works and Utilities facility to handle population growth. Additionally, reconstruction projects are ongoing, including work on Mark Drive and intersection improvements at Legion Street and West Verona Avenue.
We have plenty of activity in town, including Yoga at Insight Wellness today, ART House 360 events tonight, and Hop Haus Trivia tomorrow.
In police news, on November 9, an officer stopped a driver on USH 18/151 who was swerving and subsequently arrested for a third offence of O W I.
Stop by Culver's today to enjoy the Flavor of the Day, Double Strawberry, before they close their doors at 10:00 PM.
